verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a broad admin API surface: the Directory API manages users and admins (docs-22, docs-5) and tracks and wipes devices (docs-23). The Reports API covers audit and usage reports (docs-6), the admin APIs cover alerts, SSO and email routing settings (docs-2, docs-3), the Cloud Identity API handles identity resources and dynamic groups (docs-7, docs-30), and Apps Script can automate Admin console tasks (docs-14). Nothing in the pack claims full UI parity, though, and several console-documented features have no API evidence, including Context-Aware Access policies, 2SV enforcement and mobile password requirements (docs-15, docs-16, docs-9). Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage of security policies such as CAA and 2SV, end-user app (Gmail/Drive/Docs) API coverage in evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.
